name: @mm/rules-raid
description: Engagement space, combat, objectives, and raid consequences — the behaviour behind contracts.md §1.6 and the combat resolution §8 leaves to this package.
author: Ann Kelner
//: Rules-path code: no third-party runtime dependencies, no Node built-ins, integer-only. Per contracts.md §5 this is the coordinating layer that may import BOTH rules-magic and rules-world, plus coordination for the world-state port a raid's consequences land through — and MUST NOT import agent-api. @mm/content is declared but imported for TYPES ONLY, following rules-magic: content's public surface re-exports a filesystem loader, and this package builds under `types: []` so it runs unchanged in a browser.
